tag: overnight position, no working exits; ledger reconciled
note: The last setup (short 3 at 13:29:01, avg 29452.67) never exited: NinjaTrader was closed at 17:26 with the position open and its working target and stop died with it (sim orders do not survive the platform). The position was closed by hand at 09:14:34 on 09-10 at 29070.25, about +$2,290 after costs, booked here so it pairs with its setup. This is a mechanics windfall, not the rule: the base target at 29417.00 would have filled on the evening decline for about +$143, and the runner's two-brick trail outcome is not reconstructed. Also on this day and every other day so far, the strategy's log recorded only the last part of each partial fill (entries and exits), which the close-out had been reading as positions left open; the missing legs are added from the NT8 execution log (site/data/manual-fills.csv, analysis/reconcile_fills.py).

NinjaTrader froze at about 09:32 (the machine had not been restarted that day; NT8 left running across days freezes). The watchdog saw no quote for 65 s and tripped at 09:33:32 with the second setup open (short 3 at 29093.50), disarmed for the day, but its flatten never filled because the platform was frozen; NT8 shut down about 09:37. NT8 restarted at 09:46 and its own Close order filled at 29166.25/29166.50, about $437 lost against about $214 had the 29129.25 stop been live; that exit is added from the NT8 log via manual-fills.csv because the strategy was disabled when it filled. The strategy was re-enabled by hand at 09:46:29 and traded again from 09:48:24 with its setup counter restarted, so those trades are outside the rule (the rule stays disarmed after a watchdog trip, and that was the session's third setup, which it skips). Day counted as a watchdog day for the two rule setups only; trades after 09:46 are not scored. Cause: platform, not feed and not the rule. Update 09-11: a daily restart did not prevent a full-system freeze the next day; the working diagnosis is the display chain (DisplayLink USB monitor adapter plus a stale NVIDIA driver), see the 09-11 note.

The whole PC froze at about 10:15 (cursor moved, nothing else; Kernel-Power 41 on the next boot) and needed a hard power-off. The strategy was flat at the time (last trade closed 10:00:03) and nothing ran for the rest of the session, so the day is a partial session on five rule setups. NT8 had also been restarted at 09:01 that morning (the 08:27 instance stopped logging at 08:43). The user's diagnosis after Event Viewer and Reliability Monitor: display-driver instability under heavy chart load, not the feed and not the rule; LiveKernelEvent 141 on 09-08 (a GPU watchdog recovery), NT8 'stopped responding' on 09-10, and the freeze today. Suspects: a DisplayLink USB adapter driving one of four monitors, and an NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti driver from 2025-06. Plan: move that monitor to a direct GPU output and uninstall DisplayLink; if freezes persist, clean-reinstall the NVIDIA driver with DDU.
